title: Add HumbleControl embed handshake responder
summary: Add a read-only HumbleControl iframe handshake responder to the static HumbleStudio web viewer so embedded Studio previews can confirm the selected app and session back to Control.
acceptance_criteria: HumbleStudio reads the HumbleControl embed context from `hc*` URL parameters.
Handshake requests are accepted only when schema, direction, mode, `writes:false`, app id, session id, and Control origin match the URL context.
HumbleStudio replies with `humble-studio:embed-ready` using schema `humble.control.studio-handshake.v1`, read-only mode, matching app id/session id, and `writes:false`.
The responder does not mutate loaded configs, generate exports, write files, or unlock any apply flow.
Local static checks cover JavaScript syntax and deterministic handshake helper behavior.
Workflow checks confirm the web fallback and ticket metadata remain valid.

evidence.note: Added the static web viewer embed bridge constants, URL context parser, read-only handshake request parser, context/origin matcher, ready response builder, and message listener bootstrap.
Handshake responder accepts only matching HumbleControl embed context messages and replies with humble-studio:embed-ready without mutating config, exports, files, or apply state.
Mocked browser runtime confirmed a valid HumbleControl request receives a humble-studio:embed-ready reply and a wrong-origin request is ignored.
Ticket metadata validation passed for 88 tickets.
Workflow-only local checks passed, including tickets, repo contract, script compile, web fallback, and whitespace.
Strict doctor is blocked by active topic-branch freshness expectations for this lane; implementation-specific checks above passed.

trigger.source_ref: Jan asked to continue after HumbleControl gained the iframe handshake listener.

agent_notes: This slice intentionally implements only the static web viewer responder. Native macOS WebView parity can follow separately if needed.
